summary: Add independent multi-node miner anchor gap acceptance
details: Add isolated gap 0/1/2 controls against validators delayed by one, two or three committed BTC heights, using real independent Core, balance-history and indexer stores.
Exercise mixed miner policies, progressive small-M anchor exhaustion, timed upstream delays and automatic fault recovery; audit canonical selectors, execution state and both beneficiaries.
Record submitted-work identity, bounded validation failures and unresolved import observations without inventing wire receipt times. Keep existing fault and restart fixtures explicitly at gap zero.
Wire bounded controls into a separate Nightly shard and mixed policies, 10/30/60/120-second delays and competing branches into Weekly. Delayed fake PoW is functional evidence only.
